name: Sri Seetha Rama Choultry
description: 94 economy rooms available. Highly budget-friendly baseline accommodation. Advance bookings require 1 day rent + 50% caution deposit (1.5 total) via MeeSeva or DD 30 days ahead.

name: Old Centenary Cottages
description: 64 massive cottage variants featuring 4 large beds per room. Highly optimal for larger groups and traditional families.

name: New Centenary Cottages
description: 32 economy multi-bed rooms available. Budget-friendly choice located near the primary foot steps.

name: Satya Niketan
description: 62 economy rooms available. Features extensive open backside courtyard space dedicated for performing family events and mass marriages.

name: Prakash Sadan
description: 41 spacious ordinary rooms available. Excellent proximity to the main queue line complex. Requires an equivalent refundable caution deposit at check-in.

name: Siva Sadan
description: 116 premium standard rooms. Highly sanitized, spacious rooms offering superb hillside views, attached modern clean bathrooms, and proximity to canteens.

name: Mythri Residency
description: Premium private stay located directly facing the main entry ghat road. Features free Wi-Fi, elevator/lift, air-conditioned rooms, parking, and dedicated room service.

name: SAL Residency
description: Located on Gateway Main Road, opposite the Swamy Vari Temple; features free Wi-Fi, parking, restaurant, and 24-hour front desk.

name: Hotel Volety Grand
description: Located on the Annavaram bypass road; offers spacious rooms, elevator, and restaurant facilities.

name: Spree One Resort & Convention
description: Premium resort featuring outdoor swimming pool, kids' pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, Wi-Fi, and parking.

name: Tirumala Residency
description: Lodge accommodation located in Ramraju Nagar / Bendapudi area with Wi-Fi and parking facilities.
